proposal.summary: CP Blocks WordPress plugin before 1.0.15 does not sanitize and escape its "License ID" settings, allowing high-privilege users to perform Cross-Site Scripting attacks even when unfiltered_html is disallowed.
proposal.cwe_quote: "does not sanitise and escape its \"License ID\" settings"

PR.quote: "allow high privilege users to perform Cross-Site Scripting attacks"

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerability by testing the License ID setting for stored/reflected XSS in a non-production environment, capture proof-of-concept payload behaviour, and confirm the minimum privileges required. If confirmed, coordinate disclosure and recommend updating to version 1.0.15 or applying proper sanitization/escaping on the License ID field.

evidence_quotes.quote: does not sanitise and escape its "License ID" settings
allow high privilege users to perform Cross-Site Scripting attacks even when the unfiltered_html is disallowed
